author: opencode-worker-2
text: Worker-2 round state (released per TIMEBOX): scaffold + full ztest suite WRITTEN but the runtime fails on a native_sim thread-priority assertion — do not commit until resolved. Current files (uncommitted in worker2 tree, all present): lichen/tests/desync_fsm/{prj.conf, testcase.yaml, CMakeLists.txt, src/main.c, boards/native_sim_native_64.conf, boards/native_sim_native_64.overlay}. Kconfig chain SOLVED (for the next attempt, prj.conf needs): ZTEST + NETWORKING/NET_IPV6/NET_L2_DUMMY/SERIAL/RING_BUFFER + LICHEN + LICHEN_LINK=y + LORA=y + LICHEN_HAL=y + LICHEN_L2=y + LICHEN_ROUTING=y + LICHEN_RPL=y + SETTINGS=y + LICHEN_LINK_EPOCH_PERSIST=y + LICHEN_LINK_CCP16_LOAD_BALANCING=y (explicit; it is select-ed via LICHEN_CCP_TDMA but Kconfig warnings abort the build, so set every link of the chain explicitly) + LICHEN_TDMA=y + COAP_SERVER=y + COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE=896 (the LCI resources' BUILD_ASSERTs) + NUM_PREEMPT_PRIORITIES=16/NUM_COOP_PRIORITIES=16. Boards conf/overlay: copy the lora0 loopback alias + LORA_LOOPBACK/LICHEN_L2_DEV_PROVISIONING lines from lichen/apps/puck/boards/native_sim_native_64.{conf,overlay}. REMAINING BLOCKER: runtime aborts at kernel/thread.c:517 — a thread is created with prio == NUM_PREEMPT_PRIORITIES (assertion tracks the constant when widened), i.e. some thread in the L2/CoAP/net chain derives its priority from NUM_PREEMPT instead of staying inside [−16, NUM_PREEMPT−2]; candidates: Zephyr CoAP service thread, net TX/RX threads, or the SLIP RX thread (SLIP_TRANSPORT_RX_THREAD_PRIORITY default 7 — fine). Next steps: identify the offending thread via gdb/Z_LOG on the native_sim binary, fix its priority source, run. The test main.c content itself is complete and mirrors python sfn.py DesyncFSM + ccp16-desync.json trigger scenarios.
